evidence_boundary: Synthetic charge-sharing and variation model using v14J extracted SKY130 MIM capacitance proxies. No fabricated v14L release device exists yet.

passive_fanout_rejection.conclusion: A single passive charged capacitor cannot regenerate a same-threshold chain; local stored energy is required.

transistor_break_even_targets.energy_rule: E_VRS must be below C_logic * VDD^2 because coupling/replenishment is common to both references.

decision: Keep the pre-biased locally regenerative capacitor-centered architecture. Reject passive one-capacitor propagation. Physical promotion is blocked on VRS switching energy, delay, leakage, variation and BEOL integration.
